[FACT] User is looking for a recipe for chicken and vegetable stir-fry.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a basic chicken and vegetable stir-fry recipe with servings for 4-6.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ingredients for the stir-fry include: 1 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs, 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, 1 onion, 2 cloves garlic, 1 bell pepper, 2 cups mixed vegetables, 2 teaspoons soy sauce, 1 teaspoon oyster sauce, salt and pepper, and cooked rice or noodles for serving.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for the stir-fry include preparing ingredients, heating the wok, cooking chicken, softening vegetables, adding mixed vegetables, returning chicken, adding seasonings, and serving.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Customization ideas for the stir-fry include adding different proteins, changing vegetables, adding spice, adding crunch, and making it a one-pot meal.  
[PREFERENCE] User likes the recipe but wants to use leftover vegetables.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant confirmed that leftover vegetables can be substituted in the stir-fry and provided tips on how to do so.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested vegetables for stir-fry include leafy greens, cruciferous vegetables, root vegetables, mushrooms, alliums, and others.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips for using leftover vegetables, including adjusting cooking times and methods based on the type of vegetables used.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a Thai green curry recipe with servings for 4-6.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ingredients for the Thai green curry include: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, 2-3 cloves garlic, 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger, 2 tablespoons Thai green curry paste, 2 cups mixed vegetables, 1 can coconut milk, 1 cup chicken or vegetable broth, 1 tablespoon fish sauce, 1 teaspoon palm sugar, 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin, 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder, salt and pepper, and cooked rice or noodles for serving.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for the Thai green curry include preparing the curry paste, heating oil, sautéing aromatics, adding curry paste, adding mixed vegetables, adding coconut milk and broth, adding flavorings, simmering, and serving.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips and variations for the Thai green curry include using a variety of vegetables, adjusting spiciness, and experimenting with different proteins.
